types.label: Nothing is building
types.description: No build is running while the Queue has work (with the reason: no free account, no Fable account, a split still to come), or the Queue is empty and builds wait in Pending for you. Pushed to the phone once per idle spell; cleared when a build runs.

types.label: Dispatcher self-check
types.description: The dispatcher checked every Claude account one by one (signed in, limited, API key saved and not rejected, free slots) and either fixed something (released a slot held by an ended session, cleared an expired limit, put a build that never ran back in the Queue) or found an account it can't use, with what to do.

types.label: Build start (veto)
types.description: Before every build start (first run, retry, rerun, next phase): one heads-up pop-up on AmberX, mirrored in the console (Build orchestrator → Pipeline → Waiting to start), with the build, what it will do, steps, model, account and employee, Approve, Deny and a countdown (vetoSeconds, default 90 s). It starts on Approve or when the countdown ends; Deny sends it back to Pending. The launch then updates the same notification to 'Started: <build> on <account> (<model>)'. A tap opens that build. With auto-approve on there is no hold and notifyStart decides the Started pop-up.

types.label: Build finished (built, failed or needs you)
types.description: Every time a build's session ends: a heads-up pop-up on AmberX reading 'Finished: <build> on <account>, <outcome>, <done>/<total> steps', plus what it needs when it needs you. A tap opens that build. Also in the Activity feed. Off in Build orchestrator → Pipeline → Phone pop-ups (notifyFinish), with the Claude setting Build done, or here.

types.label: Build ready to merge
types.description: After a build's finish, when its PR is open, not a draft and its checks are green: the same AmberX notification turns into 'Ready to merge: <build>, PR #n, CI green'. A tap opens the build. Off in Build orchestrator → Pipeline → Phone pop-ups (notifyReady) or here.

types.label: Build merged
types.description: When a build's PR is merged (the merge queue landed it on main): the build's notification turns into 'Merged: <build>, PR #n'. Off in Phone pop-ups (notifyMerged) or here.

types.label: Build live
types.description: When the console is redeployed with a build's merge commit (deploy log): the build's notification turns into 'Live: <build> live on the console'. Off in Phone pop-ups (notifyLive) or here.

types.label: Build split into steps
types.description: The orchestrator split a new build into steps (or had to fall back to rules and asks you to review them).
